author: pool_physics

source_review.scope: Non-author independently read original research text and selected figures; no experiments, videos, complete scripts or equation-by-equation mathematical proof audit.

readings.method: web-rendered research paper text, sections 3-6, printed pp.4-13; figure captions, not image inspection or supplementary video
readings.checks: 衝擊與自由端／繩圈慣性配合是研究假說，端重與方向的控制支持其作用；側向未失敗組滑移不單調。結心變形未直接量到，強弱結扭轉原因未證明，材質與表面未測，不能轉成普遍防鬆配方。
readings.access_limits: PMC direct open returned browser check; eScholarship noSplash timeout, alternate PDF429, landing captcha, Royal Society403. No retries after429. Successful reading used the same original paper as reproduced on ResearchGate, not an independent replication.

readings.method: Independently read author-downloaded PDF text pp.2-6,8; repository metadata read live via arXiv abstract page
readings.checks: 穩態模型以動量通量說明取鏈區額外向上反作用；模型對兩珠鏈較好，條鏈較差。不要把單一鏈節轉動模型說成所有取鏈情境的唯一原因，也不可說重力失效。

readings.method: Independently read author-downloaded PDF text pp.2-6; root visually inspected p.3 Fig.3-4
readings.checks: 同落差下，盤繞和含扭折的放置方式有不同拱高；盤緣並非必要條件。扭折後回甩是這篇提出的解釋，不是所有鏈條已確證的通則。圖4圖說b/c有文字錯置，依正文與圖像辨讀。

readings.identity: Cross and Wheatland, Modeling a falling slinky; arXiv1208.4629v1, 2012-08-22; DOI10.1119/1.4750489
readings.method: Independently read author-downloaded PDF text pp.2-3,10-14 and visually inspected p.21 Fig.2; not video
readings.checks: 限定先垂直靜止懸掛的張力彈簧：卸載／塌縮由上往下，底端暫未失去支撐，不是重力延遲。兩實物擬合為定性吻合；彈簧參數、綁起上圈和有限塌縮時間影響結果，不套固定懸停秒數到任意彈簧。

readings.identity: Rauch-Wojciechowski and Rutstam; SIGMA10(2014)017; DOI10.3842/SIGMA.2014.017; arXiv1306.2470v3
readings.method: Independently read author-downloaded PDF text pp.1-4; root visually inspected p.2 Fig.1; version metadata read live via arXiv
readings.checks: 模型含偏心質心、持續接觸、滑動摩擦與轉動條件；摩擦力矩容許旋轉能轉為位能且總機械能仍下降。不是所有陀螺快轉都會翻面，也不能把摩擦說成供應能量。

readings.identity: Kondo and Nakanishi; DOI10.1103/PhysRevE.95.062207; arXiv1704.06717v2 submitted2017-06-11, PDF dated2017-06-13
readings.method: Independently read author-downloaded PDF pp.1-6,9-11; root visually inspected p.3 Fig.2; version metadata read live via arXiv
readings.checks: 慣性主軸和曲率主軸錯位，使搖擺和旋轉耦合；不可寫成角動量憑空反轉或單靠旋轉慣性。本文最小模型無滑動且無耗散，小振幅小轉速近似可反轉兩方向，高速有不反轉情形；不要宣稱一方向永遠穩定或任意轉速必反轉。

source_review.source_identity_limit: arXiv repository versions, journal identifiers and duplicate hosting pages identify works; URLs are not independent experimental confirmations. Cached PDFs came from this batch's author fetch with declared editorial User-Agent; root's contribution is independent reading, not a second HTTP fetch.

advisory.limits: All historical URLs plus historical research-reading titles/versions and within-new comparisons. Exact normalized-title, DOI-string and URL comparisons only; not a semantic bibliography deduplication or external fetch. Different URLs can be copies of the same paper and must not be described as independent evidence.

source_identity_review.conclusion: 六篇工作；鞋帶兩載體與期刊/arXiv副本不各算研究。精確舊URL/題名/DOI比對無命中，不能推成所有來源別名都無重複。
